title: The Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987
full_text: The Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 null Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 198739 Act Number: 39 Enactment Date: 1987-10-11 Act Year: 1987 Short Title: The Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 Long Title: An Act to constitute legal services authorities to provide free and competent legal services to the weaker sections of the society to ensure that opportunities for securing justice are not denied to any citizen by reason of economic or other disabilities, and to organise Lok Adalats to secure that the operation of the legal system promotes justice on a basis of equal opportunity. Department: Department of LAW AND LEGISLATIVE AFFAIRS Enforcement Date: 09-11-1995 Type: CENTRAL ACT (Ministry of Law and Justice, Department of Justice) Location: Chhattisgarh Notification: 9th November, 1995, vide notification No. S.O. 893(E), dated 9th November, 1995, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, sec. 3(ii).
